he Doubter: this is the place — finish it.
[2026-09-01T18:48:09.828Z] [world] Time and the wasteland have worked this place over since you last passed through — there's something worth a second look again.
[2026-09-01T18:48:09.839Z] [world] A scout crouches at the treeline, reading the ground. They rise slow and easy, hands where you can see them. This is Vesna, a lone scout. (Try "talk to Vesna" — a fair word carries.)
[2026-09-01T18:48:09.843Z] [world] You've left The Monarch's Waystation and entered The Reaver's Crest. The crest gives you the whole borderland, and gives the whole borderland you. It's dawn. Nobody else is in sight. north leads to The Monarch's Waystation; east leads to Sinking Cathedral; west leads to Raider's Ridge. Nothing named to the south.
[2026-09-01T18:48:09.843Z] [world] You have been here. The shape of it comes back before the details do.

[2026-09-01T18:48:09.848Z] [arbiter] "Three things in this place would reward attention," the Arbiter says, without naming them. "I would start with the one you cannot quite see."
[2026-09-01T18:48:09.856Z] [world] The Reaver is on the ridge the sign named, alone, watching you climb. He doesn't draw until you crest it. "The Giants will rise," he says, almost gentle. "You are a small thing to send against that." Then his blade comes up.
[2026-09-01T18:48:09.856Z] [combat] Tartarian Reaver (hunted) closes the distance. The hunt comes to its end.
[2026-09-01T18:48:09.856Z] [combat] The Reaver rises on the ridge line: "You climbed all this way to die tired. Come, then."
